neighbours.label: the sub-word token 'ag' / 'agg' / 'AG' (and short 'wag'/'Wags') when it is split out as its own piece inside a word, e.g. h|agg|is, papag|ay|os, Fam|ag|usta, AG|H; whole-word tokens that merely contain 'ag' (swagger, bagel, exaggeration) stay quiet
fire: He told a joke full of waggery and wit.
Los papagayos volaban sobre la selva.
We visited the old walls of Famagusta.
AGH! I dropped my phone again.
Bilbo Baggins wondered what Gandalf was thinking.
quiet: He told a joke full of exaggeration and wit.
Los pajaros volaban sobre la selva.
We visited the old walls of Magdeburg.
Ugh! I dropped my phone again.
Bilbo Bagshot wondered what Gandalf was thinking.
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 spelling unit. Near misses keep frame and length and mostly keep the letters 'ag', but in whole-word or differently split tokens (' swagger', ' bag'+'el', ' Mag', ' Bag'). Feeds the 'ap|ag' detector at L1/N11257- (apagar, apagón, Papagaien). Mapped live on the Let's Play stream; chat was quiet, so the sentences are the agent's own.
